title: Claude Code: Missing Opus Model Option Despite Max Plan Access
body:
**Bug Description**
The /model command only gives me option to use Sonnet not Opus 4.1  Says /upgrade to Max plan.  BUT I am on a Max plan and logged in as such. The /status and /cost confirm that.

**Environment Info**

- Terminal: WarpTerminal
- Version: 1.0.81
